data.explanation: This is a routine quarterly bill for the German broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag), which is owed for every household. The monthly rate of €18.36 is billed every three months in advance, so pay the €55.08 by the due date shown to avoid a reminder or enforcement action. You can pay by bank transfer using the IBAN given, or set up a direct debit mandate to avoid future manual payments. If you receive certain social benefits (e.g. BAföG), you may apply for an exemption from the fee.
